title: OUTCOME
description: What a goal actually produced. The denominator: spend divided by accepted outcomes is the only cost number that means anything, and without this there is nothing to divide by.

accepted.description: Did it meet the goal's own measure. Not whether work happened - work always happens.

measure.description: The result against the measure the goal declared.

humanTouches.description: How many times a person had to act. The leverage number: spend can fall while this rises, and that is not an improvement.

waitedForHumanSeconds.description: Time the work sat idle inside an approved envelope waiting for a person.

sideEffects.description: What left the building and cannot be taken back.
